_comment: Golden test vectors for the official PoE2 passive-tree share code (format version 7). Captured 2026-06-26 from pathofexile2.com for the same character/tree under three allocation states. Used by the codec (public/js/passive-code.js) round-trip tests: decode(code) must yield the documented state, and encode(decode(code)) must reproduce the code byte-for-byte. URL-safe base64 (- and _).

_format_v7_confirmed.header: version uint32 BE (=7), class uint8 (=10 for these), ascendancy uint8 (0=none, 1=first ascendancy), then a count field (uint16 BE).
_format_v7_confirmed.main_nodes: allocated node hashes decode to uint16 values that all validate against Default.json passives keys.
_format_v7_confirmed.weapon_set_section: present only when weapon-set passives are allocated (A,B have it; C does not).
_format_v7_confirmed.ascendancy_section: present only when an ascendancy is chosen (B,C have it; A does not).
_format_v7_confirmed.open_detail: exact per-record framing (tag/extra words seen as 0x3a4f/0x66b9/0xdebe on some main records; SS markers 01/02/03 on trailing records) and section length prefixes to be finalized against these fixtures during implementation.

vectors.name: A_noasc_weaponset
vectors.description: No ascendancy chosen; some weapon-set passives allocated.

vectors.name: B_asc_weaponset
vectors.description: Same tree as A, plus an ascendancy chosen (index 1); weapon-set passives still allocated.

vectors.name: C_asc_noweaponset
vectors.description: Same tree as B (ascendancy index 1) but with the weapon-set passives removed.
